hitter.label: G (with a PA)
hitter.desc: Games with a plate appearance (defensive replacements and pinch runners without a PA are not counted).

hitter.label: AB
hitter.desc: At-bats: PA minus walks, HBP, sacrifices and catcher's interference.

hitter.label: uBB
hitter.desc: Unintentional walks (MLB's BB includes IBB: add the IBB column).

hitter.label: OBP
hitter.desc: (H + BB + IBB + HBP) / (AB + BB + IBB + HBP + SF).

hitter.label: wOBA
hitter.desc: Savant's woba_value summed over woba_denom: linear weights of each PA result, scaled to OBP.

pitcher.label: IP
pitcher.desc: Innings pitched (outs / 3; shown as decimal innings).

pitcher.label: uBB
pitcher.desc: Unintentional walks (MLB's BB includes IBB: add the IBB column).

pitcher.label: R (on the mound)
pitcher.desc: Runs scored while the pitcher was on the mound: inherited runners are not reassigned to the pitcher who put them on, and these are not earned runs.

pitcher.label: FIP
pitcher.desc: Fielding-independent pitching on the RA9 scale.

presets.label: Fastball VAA against fastball whiff rate
